commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

forgeAccountId.description: A forge account's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

url.description: The forge's URL in any form git takes, or a repository's on it: only its origin is kept.

kind.description: The kind of forge the URL is on: github, forgejo, gitea; optional for github.com, which is GitHub. gitlab is reserved for milestone 2.

slug.description: The slug its variables are named by; derived from the host when absent.

primary.description: Make it the primary forge, clearing the one that is. The first forge account is primary whatever this says.

token.description: A forge token as pasted, trimmed: 1 to 4096 characters with no white space. It crosses the wire once and is never answered back.

oneOf.description: A pasted token, which the environment keeps in its vault.

credential.description: The credential a forge account is given: a pasted token, stored in the environment's vault and never answered back.
